description: R&D: categorical derivation of c_4 via direct H_3/H_4 Markov-trace h-expansion at the canonical Borromean braid (σ_1 σ_2^{-1})^3. Symbolic in q via sympy; extracts the h⁴ coefficient of the half-symmetric Wedderburn trace.

c4_structural_target.categorical_source: The h⁴ coefficient of the half-symmetric Wedderburn Markov-trace expansion at the canonical Borromean braid (σ_1 σ_2^{-1})^3 in H_3(q), stabilised to H_4 via σ_3 · z-weight.
c4_structural_target.explicit_form_pending: Requires the Hoefsmit seminormal-form 2x2 matrix product for σ_1 σ_2^{-1} on V_(2,1), cubed, and traced. The χ_(2,1) character at the Borromean braid is the load-bearing symbolic computation.

next_RandD.approach_A: Symbolic computation: derive χ_(2,1)((σ_1 σ_2^{-1})^3) in closed form via Hoefsmit seminormal matrices. See content/quantum-observable-universe/braids-and-knots/chi-v21-hoefsmit-matrix-derivation.md for the matrix convention.
next_RandD.approach_B: Yekutieli-Stokes 4th-order: extend the 2nd-order argument (τ^(2) = -G via curvature) to 4th order. The 4th-order term involves the wedge product F ∧ F integrated over Σ_β, which is the Chern-Simons invariant of B_3 at the categorical level corresponding to k=4.
next_RandD.approach_C: Direct H_4 stabilised computation: Markov-stabilise the B_3 Borromean braid to B_4 via σ_3, compute the Wedderburn characters χ_λ at H_4 for all 5 partitions of 4, project to the half-symmetric component, expand in h, extract h⁴ coefficient. This is the direct categorical derivation (slow but rigorous).

caveats: Categorical derivation incomplete — script identifies the structural target and the load-bearing computational step (Hoefsmit matrix product for χ_(2,1) at the Borromean braid). PSLQ-based searches confirmed in prior probe that c_4 has no simple closed form in the obvious substrate bases.
